name: Call of Earth
summary: After the first communion with the land spirits in Mulgore, a young tauren shaman returns to Camp Narache with a gift from the earth. Drinking the Earth Sapta lets the initiate speak directly with a spirit manifestation and receive raw stone, binding them to the first of the four elements.

sections.title: A Gift from the Mountain
sections.body: After drinking the Earth Sapta, you meet the Minor Manifestation of Earth atop the crags near Red Cloud Mesa. The spirit gives you a plain Rough Quartz. It represents your pact with the element and the endurance of stone. The spirit reminds you that patience and strength are the virtues the earth demands, and promises harmony with the land through mutual respect.

sections.title: The First Totem
sections.body: At Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather shapes the gifted quartz into your first Earth Totem. The totem is more than a mark of status: it is a lasting physical and spiritual anchor. Through this carved focus, you channel the earth’s grounding, protective magic and take your first true step along the fourfold elemental path.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Rough Quartz?
aliases: why do i need rough quartz
faq.answer: The Rough Quartz is a token the Minor Manifestation of Earth gives you as proof of communion. Seer Ravenfeather uses it as the spiritual heart of your new Earth Totem.

faq.q: Why is an Earth Totem so important to a shaman?
aliases: why do i need earth totem
faq.answer: Totems let a shaman channel elemental power. Without an Earth Totem as a focus, a shaman cannot petition the land spirits to manifest spells and protective wards.

Seer Ravenfeather is the spiritual guide and shaman trainer at Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa. She oversees young tauren’s elemental trials, guides them through their first visions, and crafts their sacred implements.

faq.q: What are the four paths Seer Ravenfeather mentions?
faq.answer: Seer Ravenfeather means the four primal elements a shaman must master: Earth, Fire, Water, and Air. Earth is the foundation, representing endurance and steadfastness, and it is the initiate’s first trial.

faq.q: Where does this communion take place?
aliases: where do i find the earth spirit
faq.answer: The communion takes place among the rugged cliffs bordering Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. You can reach the Minor Manifestation of Earth only after drinking the Earth Sapta.

faq.q: Do other Horde shamans undertake a similar rite?
aliases: do orcs do call of earth
do all shamans get earth totem
faq.answer: Yes. Orcs and Darkspear trolls in Durotar undertake their own Call of Earth in the Valley of Trials. They seek communion with local elemental manifestations and carve their first totems.

angles.text: As a shaman, this rite gives you your first totem. Carrying it grounds your spiritual identity and lets you cast essential earth-aligned wards.
Tauren culture holds the Earth Mother in profound reverence. This trial binds an initiate to the living rock and soil of their ancestral homeland.
As a Horde shaman, you serve as a spiritual anchor and advisor, bridging the mortal races with Kalimdor’s volatile elemental forces.
